mission: Track bounded, public, inspectable changes in how U.S. governmental power is allocated, checked, staffed and exercised. Preserve countervailing checks and ordinary explanations alongside possible executive-aggrandizement mechanisms. Do not predict regime outcomes, infer motives from alignment, score political actors, or treat correlation/affiliation as proof of coordination.

geography.may_localize_to_states_and_localities: only when a federal action or election-administration question requires it

baseline_lenses.name: V-Dem
baseline_lenses.use: comparative structural baseline and indicator vocabulary; expert-coded measures are context, not event-level proof

baseline_lenses.name: Bright Line Watch
baseline_lenses.use: higher-frequency expert/public pulse on democratic principles and rule-of-law conditions; survey judgment, not primary event evidence

baseline_lenses.name: Freedom House
baseline_lenses.use: annual cross-domain context and documented developments; external assessment, not canonical project scoring

include: oversight bodies, inspectors general, ethics and whistleblower protection
DOJ/FBI/prosecutorial independence and compliance with court orders
civil-service, scientific, regulatory and intelligence professional independence
military professionalism, senior leadership changes, domestic deployments and religious-affairs policy
election administration, voter-roll authority, certification, voting-system custody, federal observation/policing and displacement of state/local administrators
pressure on civil society, media, universities, law firms and other institutional intermediaries through governmental powers
doctrinal and interpretive shifts that change the practical reach of rights, executive authority or institutional checks
documented personnel and organizational networks relevant to institutional change
exclude: tactical surveillance or nonpublic tracking of service members
treating criticism or ideology alone as evidence of consolidation

review_triggers: abrupt removal or transfer of an official whose function is oversight, legal independence, scientific integrity, election administration, military professionalism or regulatory enforcement
replacement/appointment pattern that materially changes an institution's independence or reporting chain
bypass or weakening of confirmation, notice, tenure, civil-service or statutory-protection processes
documented refusal, delay or circumvention of a binding court order
use of enforcement, contracting, security-clearance, licensing or funding power against institutional critics or competitors
federal personnel or security forces inserted into election administration, record custody, certification or polling operations
new ideological, religious or loyalty-linked criteria in evaluation, promotion, assignment, deployment or access
concentration of authorities previously distributed across multiple offices
removal, consolidation, disappearance or nonpublication of oversight data needed to inspect government action
required_controls: What is the ordinary administrative/reform/readiness explanation?
What is the historical baseline across more than one administration where available?
What legal authority is claimed and what independent check remains?
What denominator would distinguish unusual churn/concentration from normal turnover?
What observable finding would weaken the consolidation interpretation?

specialist_children.question_shape: Who left, under what authority/process, who replaced them, what function changed, and what is the normal baseline?

specialist_children.trigger: change touching voter rolls, certification, ballot access, voting systems, election policing, record custody or displacement of local/state administrators
specialist_children.question_shape: What legal control moved, from whom to whom, with what implementation and countercheck?

specialist_children.trigger: leadership removals, domestic deployments, promotion/selection changes, ORA/spiritual-fitness policy or other command-professionalism questions
specialist_children.question_shape: What changed in command, evaluation, assignment or deployment rules, and what measurable effect followed?

specialist_children.trigger: a legal/administrative interpretation repeatedly appears across briefs, appointments, opinions, executive memos or advocacy networks
specialist_children.question_shape: When did this proposition last mean the same thing, where did it travel, and where did legal effect actually change?

specialist_children.trigger: a consequential office/project shows repeated personnel/organizational overlap
specialist_children.question_shape: Which publicly documented professional/organizational ties exist, compared with an appropriate baseline, without inferring private belief or coordination?

specialist_children.trigger: court-order compliance, prosecutorial targeting, legal-profession coercion or enforcement selectivity question
specialist_children.question_shape: What was ordered/required, what happened, what comparator exists, and what review/appeal/check remains?

ora_lens.scope: Office of Religious Affairs and related military spiritual-fitness policy
ora_lens.baseline_rule: Spiritual-fitness concepts predate ORA; compare pre-ORA doctrine and programs with post-ORA authorities and implementation rather than treating the concept itself as new.
track: office charter/memo, reporting line, budget, staffing and director
whether assessments are mandatory or voluntary
what data are collected, retained, shared and accessible to commanders
whether any assessment affects evaluation, promotion, assignment, deployment, clearance, schooling or discipline
appeal/accommodation paths for minority-faith and nonreligious personnel
contracts or formal partnerships with outside faith organizations
90-day inventories or funding requests for religious-affairs requirements
complaints, IG/EEO/FOIA/court records and policy corrections
ora_lens.privacy: Track published policy, aggregate patterns and public senior-role affiliations only. Never infer individual religion or nonreligion.

fortress_crosslink.subject: FORTRESS America
fortress_crosslink.rule: Treat strategic reserves, independent base power and domestic supply-chain resilience as ordinary military-readiness measures unless additional evidence changes the interpretation.
inspect_if_relevant: links to domestic deployment or continuity authorities
documented overlap with ORA personnel or organizations
fortress_crosslink.caution: Shared announcement or common departmental leadership is not evidence of ORA influence over FORTRESS. Any 'unusual overlap' claim requires a denominator/comparator.

doctrine_genealogy_seed.purpose: Track changes in interpretive frames that alter practical rights or institutional constraints without assuming one advocacy network caused the outcome.
rules: do not infer coordination from similar language alone

outputs.event_packets: bounded event records with primary-source lineage
outputs.child_requests: narrow specialist questions with stop conditions and budgets

birth_policy.auto_spawn: within existing Garden budgets/permissions when the target source/role is already approved; otherwise defer
